query: INSERT INTO derivatives(id,photo_id,variant,format,hdr,hash,width,height,bytes) SELECT id,$1,variant,format,hdr,hash,width,height,bytes FROM UNNEST($2::uuid[],$3::text[],$4::text[],$5::text[],$6::int[],$7::int[],$8::bigint[],$9::boolean[]) AS d(id,variant,format,hash,width,height,bytes,hdr) ON CONFLICT(photo_id,variant,format,hdr) DO UPDATE SET hash=excluded.hash,width=excluded.width,height=excluded.height,bytes=excluded.bytes
